=== about
append with limit 3: the oldest (first) items go.
=== page
<ul id="log"><li>1</li><li>2</li><li>3</li></ul>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #log
data: limit 3
data: elements <li>4</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #log
data: limit 3
data: elements <li>5</li><li>6</li>

=== dom
<ul id="log"><li>4</li><li>5</li><li>6</li></ul>
